claims.hypothesis: NGC 1087 hosts a bar-like non-axisymmetric structure hidden at optical wavelengths
claims.experiment: Compared MUSE optical images with JWST NIRCam F200W/F300M and fitted an elliptical light model
claims.result: Elongated structure with PA 305 deg, ellipticity 0.5 and half-major axis about 14 arcsec (1.2 kpc)
claims.finding: A faint bar-like structure exists, visible only in the near-IR

evidence.quote: This structure is not evident in the MUSE optical continuum images but only revealed in the near-IR

claims.hypothesis: The stellar, ionized and CO velocity fields show an oval distortion tied to the NIR structure
claims.experiment: Circular and bisymmetric XS models fitted to stellar, H-alpha and CO velocity maps with the bar orientation fixed
claims.result: Circular models leave about 30 km/s residuals; the bisymmetric model reproduces the twisted iso-velocities in all three maps with 15 km/s rms
claims.finding: The kinematics in all phases reflect a bar-like perturbation of the potential

evidence.quote: The spatial extension of the large-scale non-circular motions is coincident with the bar

evidence.loc: Kinematic interpretation of the oval distortion
evidence.quote: This model reproduces simultaneously the twisted iso-velocities in the three velocity maps.

claims.hypothesis: The non-circular motions are better described by gas inflow along the bar than by a bisymmetric distortion
claims.experiment: Fitted an inflow model with flow along the bar axis inside the bar region and compared rms with the bisymmetric model
claims.result: Inflow model gives the lowest rms with maximum inflow of about 50 km/s
claims.finding: Inflow is statistically favoured, but oval orbits cannot be ruled out

evidence.quote: Statistically speaking, the inflow scenario is favored over the bisymmetric model
the contribution of gas oval orbits can not be ruled out.

claims.hypothesis: Gas inflow along the bar can feed the star formation in the bar
claims.experiment: Computed Mdot_mol from CO surface density and model inflow velocity and compared with the H-alpha SFR in the bar
claims.result: Average Mdot_mol about -20 Msun/yr versus SFR(H-alpha) in the bar of 0.08 Msun/yr
claims.finding: Inflow rate exceeds the bar SFR, so inflow might feed the star formation

evidence.quote: This is larger than the measured SFR(H$\alpha$) along the bar, thus we argue that a major inflow of gas might be feeding the SF in the bar.

why_this_data.value: High-resolution public MUSE, JWST and ALMA data combined to detect a small bar missed by coarser surveys

evidence.quote: In this work, we make use of the most sophisticated data to unravel the detection of a bar in NGC 1087.

why_this_method.value: Bisymmetric model chosen because it reproduces velocity fields in bars; inflow model physically motivated by expected inflows along bar dust lanes

evidence.loc: Kinematic interpretation of the oval distortion
evidence.quote: has been shown to successfully reproduce the velocity field in bars (cite: velfit).
Our implementation of an inflow model is therefore physically motivated.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: An elongated bulge was considered but not favoured because of the large molecular gas reservoirs, since bulges tend to be quiescent

evidence.quote: The main reason this is not considered is due to the large reservoirs of molecular gas observed

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Shock ionization from bar dust lanes cannot explain the observed [O I]/H-alpha ratios with MAPPINGS V models

evidence.quote: the predicted emission-line intensities from shock models can not explain the observed \[ O I \]/H$\alpha$ line ratios

limitations_admitted.value: Bisymmetric model leaves residuals of about 15 km/s at 70 pc resolution, similar to or larger than ISM turbulence

evidence.loc: Kinematic interpretation of the oval distortion
evidence.quote: there are still residual velocities that the bisymmetric model can not account for

limitations_admitted.value: No 2D kinematic model includes both oval-orbit and inflow dynamics of bars

evidence.quote: To date, there is no a 2D-kinematic model that includes such dynamics of bars.

referee_caveats_inferred: Inflow model uses fewer free parameters, so lower rms does not by itself prove inflow over oval orbits
Mdot of about 20 Msun/yr depends on a fixed alpha_CO and large model inflow velocities, with no uncertainty given
No uncertainties are given on the bar geometry or kinematic parameters
The bar-like structure is faint and identified in part by eye, so the elliptical fit is not independently validated
